subject: Pilot burn-rate check & pricing band qualification
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samira Nadeem <samira@brightbasket.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot burn-rate check & pricing band qualification

Hi Samira — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I take this to Finance for credit approval:

What we heard (your team)
- Primary workload: customer support summarization + merchant search re-ranking for 3 product categories.
- Expected traffic profile: spiky weekdays, steady low weekends.
- Ballpark token velocity (your estimate): 80k — 400k tokens/day depending on rate of adoption (you mentioned a 3–4 week ramp).
- Target budget: $15k — $40k / month for the first production quarter.

Redwood initial ask / proposal
- Pricing band we'd qualify for: pilot blended rate between $2,000 — $2,800 per 1M tokens depending on committed monthly volume and SLA tier.
- Pilot credits: we can approve an initial credit pool for evaluation — need to confirm exact amount once you confirm expected average daily tokens.
- Extension: if pilot needs more runway, we can do a single 30-to-60 day extension conditional on a short burn-rate check (simple weekly report).

What we need from you (please reply directly)
1) A realistic expected average tokens/day during week 3 of the pilot (best guess).
2) Which procurement path do you prefer (standard PO vs. purchase through marketplace)?
3) Are there any data residency / compliance constraints beyond the standard SOC2 controls we discussed?

Attached: sample-cost-model.xlsx (worked example of burn -> spend at different $/1M token rates) and pilot-credits-terms.pdf (stub of credit T&Cs).

If you can send the avg tokens/day and preferred procurement by EOD Wed (7/14), I’ll include the numbers in the credit request and follow up with a formal credit letter.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

[attachment: sample-cost-model.xlsx (Excel, 18 KB)]

From: Samira Nadeem <samira@brightbasket.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Jackson Lee <jackson@brightbasket.com>, BrightBasket Procurement <procurement@brightbasket.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot burn-rate check & pricing band qualification

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and some more color from our side:

1) Expected tokens/day (week 3 estimate): ~250,000 tokens/day (this assumes steady mid-funnel traffic; peak days could reach ~420k).
2) Preferred procurement: ideally a standard PO; procurement team copied (procurement@brightbasket.com) will coordinate.
3) Compliance: SOC2 is sufficient for now; we’ll flag if any regional data residency needs surface as we ramp to >100k MAUs.

Budget: our internal stakeholders set a practical upper bound of $25k / month for the pilot phase — that’s flexible if we can demonstrate clear ROI.

Ask: can you confirm what a 30k USD credits grant would cover under the rates you described? Also want to see a 45-day pilot extension option — instead of 30 — since our internal rollout calendar is tight.

I attached a short export of expected sample traffic from our analytics team (two-week slice) so you can sanity check the numbers.

Thanks —
Samira Nadeem
Head of Growth, BrightBasket
[attachment: brightbasket-traffic-sample.csv (CSV, 12 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samira Nadeem <samira@brightbasket.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jackson Lee <jackson@brightbasket.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot burn-rate check & pricing band qualification

Samira — appreciate the quick reply and the traffic export (helpful). Putting a concrete proposal on the table so Procurement and your engineering team can plan: 

Credit & extension proposal (formalizing internal approval path)
- Pilot credits: $30,000 USD applied to your Redwood account immediately upon PO/credit acceptance.
- Pilot rate (blended promotional): $2,200 per 1M tokens during the pilot KPIs window (applies until credits are exhausted or pilot end-date).
- Extension: we’ll authorize a single 45-day extension for the pilot (instead of standard 30) conditioned on the weekly burn-rate check-ins you’ll provide and a brief milestone review at day 30.

Unit-economics worked example (using your 250k tokens/day estimate):
- 250k tokens/day * 30 days = 7.5M tokens/month.
- At $2,200 / 1M tokens -> gross token spend = 7.5 * $2,200 = $16,500 / month.
- $30k pilot credits would cover the first ~54 days at that rate (30k / 16.5k ≈ 1.82 months) — or roughly the full 45-day extended pilot and some buffer on a ramp day.

Contingencies & next steps
- Procurement: once you confirm PO route, I’ll loop Finance to push the credit approval through and send a credit-acceptance letter for signature.
- Tech: Camila (cc) will schedule a 30-minute onboarding call to validate the integration pattern and sampling rules for caching/prefixing — ideally tomorrow or Friday.
- Weekly checks: short email with top-line tokens/day and any anomalous spikes; we’ll confirm any further credit adjustments after day 30 if adoption outpaces estimates.

Attached: credit-approval-letter.pdf (for signature) and pilot-rate-sheet.pdf (breakdown of tiered rates beyond pilot). I’ll also create a HubSpot deal note for RWI-1394 and link it in this thread.

If you’re good, reply with: 1) PO intent (yes/no), 2) a point person for procurement signature, and 3) preferred time for onboarding call.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
